name: speak
text: Saavdhaan. Is call ki awaaz mein kuch hissa machine jaisa lag raha hai. Abhi paise mat bhejiye.

name: speak
text: Some parts of the caller voice look machine-generated. Do not send money yet. Hang up and call the person back on the number you have saved.

name: user
text: Alexa, ask Rohan if it's really him.

name: speak
text: Theek hai, main Rohan ke phone par poochh rahi hoon. Jawab aane tak paise mat bhejiye.

name: speak
text: Rohan says they are NOT calling you. This is a scam. Hang up now and do not send anything.

name: speak
text: Chetavani! Ye awaaz AI se banayi gayi lag rahi hai. Ye voice cloning scam ho sakta hai. Paise mat bhejiye, OTP mat batayiye. Main Rohan se khud poochh sakti hoon ki wo call kar rahe hain ya nahi.
